title: What's New: Page Scripting Enhancements (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Demo - Recording, Insertion Points, and Drag-and-Drop
Iterating Over List Entries with For-Each

features.name: Steps Modification in Recording
features.description: Ability to define insertion points for steps, rearrange steps via drag-and-drop, and delete any step in the recording sequence rather than only from the end.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality
caveats: Changing steps out of order can impact subsequent steps

features.name: Parameters UI Editing
features.description: Create, edit, and view parameters directly in the Business Central UI instead of manually editing YAML files.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality

features.name: Test Suites UI Creation
features.description: Create test suites directly from the Business Central UI by composing multiple scripts together, rather than manually modifying YAML files.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality
caveats: Included scripts cannot be edited in the suite and must be persisted before inclusion
Relative paths must be manually specified for scripts in different directories

features.name: Include Script Functionality
features.description: Add a new step called 'include a script' to compose multiple scripts together and pass parameters between them.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality
caveats: Recording must be persisted before including scripts
Scripts in different directories require manually specified relative paths

features.name: For-Each Row Iteration
features.description: Ability to iterate over entries in a repeater control by right-clicking and selecting 'for each row', creating a scope where steps execute for every item in the list.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality

features.name: Conditional Branching with Expression
features.description: Add a conditional step evaluated by a custom expression using 'expression is true' to dynamically control step execution based on conditions.
features.status_evidence_quote: the page scripting feature is still in preview, but it is production quality

features.name: Server-Side Headless Script Replay
features.description: Run page scripts headlessly on the server side during pipeline execution using the 'use server replay' parameter with BC Replay, eliminating browser overhead.

caveats: No video recordings produced with server replay
